items.headline: Burlington’s ward map changed. Check yours before voting.
items.summary: New boundaries are in effect for the 2026 municipal election, so some residents will vote in a different councillor race.
items.why: Your ward determines which councillor candidates and voting locations apply to you.

items.headline: Candidate nominations have closed. Here is the registered field.
items.summary: Burlington’s nomination deadline passed Aug. 21. The City’s candidate list now shows five people registered to run for mayor.
items.why: The official list shows voters who is registered in every Burlington race.

items.headline: What 26,503 fish revealed about a damaged local marsh.
items.summary: The hopeful Fishway count masks a harder restoration problem involving water quality, invasive species and low oxygen.
items.why: The count shows both ecological progress and what the Fishway cannot repair on its own.
